raw_text: Turkish President Erdogan delivered a forceful address at the OIC summit, dedicating significant time to the Kashmir issue. He called for a UN-supervised plebiscite and compared India's administration of Kashmir to apartheid-era policies. The speech was coordinated with a social media push across Turkish and Pakistani diplomatic channels amplifying key quotes.
